description: Optional, after sending a tx from trnch_buy or trnch_sell: report its hash so the volume is credited to the TRNCH account of the key's wallet once the receipt is checked on chain. Returns an acknowledgement only; it does not send, cancel or change the transaction, and a hash that is not a swap of this wallet credits nothing. Calling it twice with the same hash changes nothing. Requires the API key from trnch_register, sent as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

txHash.description: Hash of the transaction you sent.

name: trnch_confirm
title: Report a sent swap
